facts.statement: A Summer Camp community party was held in Robbie's Camp in the Greenwood Forest, with players encouraged to wear Robbie Camp clothing and bring a boom box.
facts.quote: Wear your Robbie Camp clothing, bring your boom box and get ready to dance around the campfire.

facts.statement: The US and Latin America party ran Thursday June 17th, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday June 17th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe party ran Friday June 18th at 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday June 18th 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a Community Event, the Robbie's Camp Party, held in Robbie's Camp in the Greenwood Forest on Server 1, with separate times for US/Latin America and UK/Europe. It also explains how players reach community events through the Game Guide calendar and GO button.
